title: EventBus callback event object structure isolation contract

contract.event_object_isolation: Each callback receives an independent event object
contract.structure_mutation_isolation: Replacing, removing, or adding event fields in one callback does not affect subsequent callbacks
contract.data_replacement_isolation: Replacing the complete data object in one callback does not affect subsequent callbacks
contract.metadata_isolation: Removing or changing event metadata does not affect subsequent callbacks
contract.callback_independence: Callback-local event structure mutations remain local to that callback
contract.source_payload_integrity: Event object mutations do not modify the original emitter payload
contract.emit_success: EventBus.emit() remains successful after callback event structure mutations
contract.registry_stability: Event structure mutations do not modify the listener registry
contract.permission_enforcement: EventBus event delivery continues to require the events permission
